name: Epitalon

protocolDosing.frequency: once daily in a 10-20 day course
protocolDosing.notes: Khavinson protocol; single-source Russian literature, no validated human PK

effects: Synthetic tetrapeptide derived from bovine pineal gland (epithalamin) — developed by V. Khavinson
Activates telomerase expression — extends telomere length in cell culture studies
Longevity research: rodent studies show life extension 20–50%; no human RCT longevity data
Normalizes circadian rhythms and melatonin production via pineal regulation
Anti-oxidant, anti-cancer effects in animal models; may reduce tumor incidence
Typical cycle: 5–10 mg/day SC × 10–20 days, repeated 2–3x/year
No established safety profile in humans; no serious adverse events reported in small studies
Sourced from research-chemical suppliers — purity and sterility not guaranteed; risk of contamination
